strongest_angle: Daewoo Engineering & Construction partnered with Ballast Nedam and Trelleborg to construct the Middle East's first immersed tunnel beneath the Khor Al-Zubair waterway in Iraq, submerging ten 47,000-tonne concrete segments.

key_facts.fact: Ballast Nedam and Ashtead Technology positioned 10 precast concrete tunnel elements, each weighing approximately 47,000 tonnes, in the Khor Al-Zubair channel for controlled immersion.

South Korean contractor Daewoo Engineering & Construction partnered with Trelleborg Marine & Infrastructure to supply customized sealing systems for the immersed tunnel beneath the Khor Al-Zubair waterway.
Daewoo Engineering & Construction secured 9 contracts worth $3.78 billion for Iraq's Al Faw Port project, including $510 million for container terminal quay wall construction.
The General Company for Ports of Iraq and South Korea's Daewoo Engineering & Construction constructed the Khor Al-Zubair immersed tunnel to connect the Faw Peninsula with Umm Qasr in Basra.
